parts.name: 从零写出 C++ 程序

chapters.title: 首次构建与诊断
chapters.learning_output: 在 Linux/WSL 与 GCC 主线上从空目录编译、链接、运行程序，并区分三个错误阶段。

chapters.title: 变量、类型、表达式与控制流
chapters.learning_output: 使用静态类型、初始化、运算符、分支和循环完成可运行的行情筛选任务。

chapters.title: 函数、引用、const 与多文件组织
chapters.learning_output: 把单文件程序拆成函数、声明、定义、头文件和实现文件，并解释参数传递。

chapters.title: 标准数据工具、算法与 CSV
chapters.learning_output: 使用 string、vector、迭代器、算法和 lambda 读取并校验 CSV 行情。

chapters.title: 类与行情分析器
chapters.learning_output: 使用 struct、class、枚举和构造函数交付多文件行情分析命令行程序。

chapters.title: 对象生命周期、RAII 与所有权
chapters.learning_output: 从生命周期推理复制移动、引用、裸指针识读、RAII 和智能指针选择。

chapters.title: STL 与 ranges
chapters.learning_output: 构造生命周期清楚、结果可验证的现代量化数据管道。

chapters.title: 接口与值语义
chapters.learning_output: 把行情分析代码重构为维护订单、成交和组合不变量的组件。

chapters.title: 模板、concepts 与多态
chapters.learning_output: 从普通实现演化出有约束的泛型策略接口，并解释静态与动态多态取舍。

chapters.title: 错误处理与可观测性
chapters.learning_output: 为正常缺席、外部失败和程序员错误选择机制并保留诊断上下文。

chapters.title: CMake 与依赖
chapters.learning_output: 从干净目录复现包含库、示例和测试的 target-based CMake 工程。

chapters.title: 测试与调试工具
chapters.learning_output: 使用行为测试、GDB、警告、sanitizer 和静态分析定位真实故障。

chapters.title: 数据布局、缓存与分配
chapters.learning_output: 通过正确性受控的实验解释对象表示、局部性、分配和 false sharing。

chapters.title: Benchmark 与 profiling
chapters.learning_output: 提交包含基线、环境、样本、结论和限制的可反驳性能报告。

chapters.title: 并发、任务与背压
chapters.learning_output: 从所有权和 happens-before 推理同步、停止、异常传播和背压协议。

chapters.title: 数值稳定性与 Python 互操作
chapters.learning_output: 验证浮点算法，并设计清楚 dtype、连续性、GIL 和缓冲所有权的批量边界。

chapters.title: 演化式事件驱动回测引擎
chapters.learning_output: 把行情分析器演化为可构建、可测试、可测量且边界明确的回测引擎。

chapters.title: 量化 C++ 求职与入职
chapters.learning_output: 把逐章证据组织成面试回答、作品集叙事和入职前三个月行动计划。

units.publication_note: Linux and WSL are the executable C++ mainline; Windows-hosted MiKTeX remains the documented publication path.
Terms use the same ownership, testing, numerical, interoperability and backtest vocabulary as the chapters and project.
Foundation recovery points to runnable answers with key steps; advanced recovery distinguishes complete core implementations from hints, acceptance checks and common errors.
The route advances by chapter outputs and observable evidence rather than days read or pages completed.
C++23 facilities are mapped to existing chapters with explicit compiler, library and team-adoption boundaries.
The concurrency extension teaches acquire-release reasoning through a tested SPSC queue and separates lock-free literacy from production readiness.
Research Engineer and Quant Developer routes end in different evidence packages, including a buildable price-time order-book core.
Interview drills connect standard data structures and algorithms to quant-flavored invariants, complexity claims and runnable evidence.

foundation_runnable_answers.guidance: Build the single program first, then classify compile, link and runtime failures by the last artifact produced.
foundation_runnable_answers.acceptance: A clean CMake build prints quant-cpp-ready and the three isolated failures reach their documented stages.

foundation_runnable_answers.guidance: Trace initialization, branch decisions and loop-state updates before comparing the exact summary.
foundation_runnable_answers.acceptance: The market filter and risk-budget programs produce their independent known outputs.

foundation_runnable_answers.guidance: Separate declaration, definition and call, then follow each parameter's ownership and mutation boundary.
foundation_runnable_answers.acceptance: The multifile target links and the basis-points answer preserves the caller value.

foundation_runnable_answers.guidance: Validate stream and row shape before transforming the owned vectors; reacquire iterators after reallocation.
foundation_runnable_answers.acceptance: The fixed AAPL CSV produces the exact row, quantity and notional summary while invalid fixtures fail.

foundation_runnable_answers.guidance: Construct only valid quotes, let the analyzer maintain cross-row invariants and expose a value result.
foundation_runnable_answers.acceptance: The standalone analyzer and price-range answer pass their exact-output and invalid-input checks.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Draw the owner and observer lifetimes before selecting direct value, unique ownership or shared ownership; for the asynchronous extension, start with a by-value order and transfer a unique pointer only when copying is forbidden.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: The ownership and lifetime traces match their snapshots, the isolated dangling case is reported by ASan, and an asynchronous task never outlives a referenced local order.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Capturing a local order by reference in work that may execute after the submitting function returns, or adding shared ownership without a shared-lifetime requirement.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Materialize borrowed range results before sorting and returning them.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: The two expected prices are printed in descending order.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Returning a view that borrows a local container.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Apply fills through the portfolio seam and calculate the hand ledger first.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: Quantity, cash and equity match the independent ledger.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Testing private storage or allowing invalid domain values to construct.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Express the required strategy operation as a concept, then test both allowed and blocked decisions.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: The public decision seam distinguishes below-limit and at-limit positions.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Treating a satisfied syntactic concept as proof of trading semantics.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Inject one failure after preserving the pre-operation public snapshot.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: The rejected operation leaves the snapshot unchanged and logs once at the boundary.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Catching and logging at every layer or mutating before all checks pass.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Model the target graph before choosing PRIVATE, PUBLIC or INTERFACE propagation.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: A clean standalone build produces exercise-notional=200.00.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Confusing target creation with CTest registration or leaking private options.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Reproduce the symptom, choose the matching diagnostic tool and change only the root cause.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: Debug and Release both execute the check and print fixed-cash=799.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Changing the oracle to match the bug or relying on assert in Release.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Keep the business checksum fixed while changing only the representation hypothesis.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: The independent scan oracle remains selected=3 notional=808.00.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Generalizing one ABI observation or timing a semantically different loop.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Pass the checksum gate, retain raw samples and connect profiler share to an end-to-end budget.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: The report includes environment, all samples, median, IQR, conclusion and limitations.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Reporting the fastest run or an environment-free speedup percentage.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Define ownership, happens-before, close and stop protocols before adding threads.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: Every offered item is accepted or dropped and the exact capacity-two summary matches.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Using sleep as synchronization or expecting separate atomics to form a snapshot.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: State representation, rounding and tolerance sources before crossing the Python boundary.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: The two returns produce mean 0.025000 and sample variance 0.101250.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Calling a borrowed view zero-copy without proving dtype, stride and owner lifetime.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Follow one event through the four public seams and reconcile every ledger transition.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: The clean project build passes eleven tests and both exact summaries.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Filling missing asset prices with zero or treating order intent as a fill.

advanced_core_answers.guidance: Build every claim from a reproducible command, observable result and explicit limitation.
advanced_core_answers.acceptance: The evidence package survives clean reproduction and the worked drawdown remains 25 percent.
advanced_core_answers.common_error: Claiming production, low-latency or team outcomes that the repository cannot prove.
